title: Ana Ibnal Abbas
body:
Ya husain haay husain
Ya husain ya husain
Ana ibnul Abbas - 4
<<MINI>>
Mera naam Mohammad hai Abbas ka hu beta..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar se Mujhe pehle de izne wigha maula
<<MINI>>
Mera naam Mohammad hai Abbas ka hu beta..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghaazi ki dua mai hu Naukar hu mai asghar ka
Naqsha me badal dunga nau laakh ke lashkar ka
Siffin sunakar hai..(2)
Amma ne Mujhe paala
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab ke hai do bete sadqa Ali akbar ka
Daadi ne madine me mujhko ye bataya tha
Zainab ke Jo bete hai..(2)
Dono ka hu mai sadqa
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar ki tarah maula qasim mera aaqa hai
Sehra mere aaqa ka armaane sakina hai
Marjaunga jiteji..haay(2)
Kubra Jo hui bewa
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaimo me bapa maula ek shor-e-qayamat hai
Darya ki taraf jau kya mujhko ijazat hai
Shehzadi ko ab pyasa..(2)
Mai dekh nhi sakta
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad ke pehlu me khamosh Jo baitha hai
Wo uski zaifi ka ghurbat me Sahara hai
Bach Jae mera baqir..(2)
Mai uspe Maru maula
<<DIVIDER>>
Qurban hua yawar Abbas ka shehzada Aur shukr ka ghazi ne us waqt kiya sajda
Maqtal se sada aai..(2)
Sad shukr mere maula
Ya husain ya husain..(2)
